Here one natural coefficient-level deck quotient has an explicit degree-three normal del Pezzo model, exact singularity basket, and natural nonreduced boundary with tangency, informing degeneration geometry without pretending to settle the full moduli problem. The natural divisors are forced by smoothness of the genus-three curves, not arbitrary slices.
